title: Pick a partition
story: Slurm splits Geiss-01 into partitions with different time limits. You have a quick {{mins}}-minute test to run. Find the partition with the shorter limit and report its name.

lesson.title: Partitions are queues with time limits

parts.note: List the partitions (queues). TIMELIMIT is the longest a job in that queue may run.
...in the `short` queue (or `-p short`). Without it, jobs go to the default queue, marked `*` in `sinfo`.
One GPU and an interactive shell, as before.

lesson.why: Short queues are for quick tests. A partition can only take jobs that fit inside its time limit.
lesson.without: Ask `short` for more than its limit and the job sits pending forever with the reason PartitionTimeLimit.

tasks.text: Report the partition for short tests

hints: Run `sinfo` and compare the TIMELIMIT column.
